notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is live!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added an option to fire the primary weapon manually (Please remap your controls before playing)

[*]You can now navigate in most menus digitally (Keyboard or D-Pad)

[*]Slowed down the scrolling and slightly dimmed the background on Chapter I

[*]Chapter I Mini Boss is now easier

[*]Chapter I Main Boss's spinning bullets no longer spin and do less damage

[*]Enemy bullets no longer damage your ship if your shield is above 10% capacity (Campaign)

[*]Removed the spinning enemy from Chapter I (Campaign and Arcade)

[*]Adjusted difficulty on Chapter II Main Boss: regular bullets do more damage and homing bullets do less damage

[*]Arcade Mode is now much easier in all difficulties

[/list]

Please note: due to gameplay changes, older replays are now obsolete.
